title: The Velvet Veil
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
Today, I bring you something I very, very rarely do: a non-erotic session! Listen to this if you’d like to feel the embrace of Goddess Nyx as she carries you away into the deep, dark night, her velvet cloak obscuring your thoughts, your memories… obscuring the world at large. Go into the night not just silently, but mindlessly and helplessly, completely relaxed and wholly accepting of her embrace.Even though the file is 40 minutes long, the last 15 minutes or are set on low volume with a loop which progressively gets quieter, as not to disturb you if you happen to fall asleep listening.As always, there is a script available for full spoilers, although in this case there is really nothing to spoil.Now go and have the greatest sleep of your life!
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
Click on the three “dots” to the right of the player and choosedownloadfrom the menu.If there is no “download” option, try a different browser, like Chrome or Firefox.
author: Miss Lilith
